mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: In monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%), 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the prior three months signals an economic shock that triggers market anticipation of fiscal stimulus and subsequent equity market recovery, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by >0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: When UNRATE increases by >0.5pp in 3 months, 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a demand surge outpacing supply capacity, signaling strong economic recovery and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST increases and INDPRO decreases simultaneously, 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), 60d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days during labor market recovery phases.
failure_condition: In labor market recovery periods (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM), 5d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 1.5% annualized signals sustained economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during expansionary phases.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 1.5% annualized in the prior quarter
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth rate > 1.5% annualized, 60d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS decrease) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 6%) signals aggressive monetary stimulus and fiscal support during economic distress, which anticipates a market rebound and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS decreases and UNRATE > 6%, 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month indicates a weakening supply chain and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days during recessionary supply shocks.
failure_condition: In recessionary supply shocks (INDPRO decline > 0.5% MoM), 5d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
